svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 760 x 600 mm rectangle from 3 mm mild steel plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grind the edges and round the four corners to about 10 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No holes. Mark a 572 mm circle in the middle with a centre line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each way: the drum stands on this circle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lies flat on the four blocks (580 mm square). The pan is wider

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: than the blocks by 90 mm each side, so embers from the ports land

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: rests flat on the blocks without rocking.
